unseen_generalization_benchmark.template_characteristics: Held-Out International/European Vendors, VAT formats, DD/MM/YYYY dates, simulated OCR noise

latency_waterfall_benchmark.dissection_explanation: The 4.68 ms reported previously is strictly 'Stage 4: Post-OCR Regex/NLP Field Parsing'. The table below details true end-to-end processing times across all hardware and OCR layers.

limitations_and_boundary_conditions.in_distribution_100_percent_explanation: The initial 100% classification result was achieved on in-distribution synthetic test documents. While mathematically disjoint (zero duplicate text hashes), documents shared structural schemas. When evaluated on Out-of-Distribution international documents with unfamiliar European VAT layouts and simulated OCR noise, baseline accuracy drops to ~95%, while the PyTorch Transformer maintains high resilience (~97.5%).
limitations_and_boundary_conditions.extraction_latency_clarification: The previously cited 4.68 ms measures exclusively post-OCR text extraction and regex table parsing. True end-to-end processing requires 35-50 ms for native vector PDFs and 160-250 ms for scanned documents due to image rasterization and neural OCR convolution passes.
known_failure_modes: Non-standard decimal separators (e.g. European 10.013,13 where comma denotes decimal)
Handwritten margin notes or stamps overlapping printed total numbers
Distorted low-resolution scans (<100 DPI) where OCR drops decimal points entirely
